type: Safety-stitch / interlock machine (安全缝机) with stepper motor thread trimmer
note: DOCUMENTATION LIMITATION: The only available PDF for this model is a parts manual (零件手册) and a brief mechanical user manual. It does not contain electronic control operation instructions, error codes, or parameter tables. For electronic troubleshooting, refer to the W4-UT or W4-D manuals if the controller is the same family, or request the W5E electronic control manual separately.

electronicComponents.description: Parts list section 25 (电控专用件 — Electronic control specific parts) lists the following without detail:
electronicComponents.threadTrimmer: Stepper motor-based thread trimmer system (W5E步进剪线专用件 — Section 26 of parts list)

specs.lubrication: ISO VG22 oil; fill between H and L lines. Apply 2-3 drops manually after long periods of non-use.

troubleshooting.issue: Electronic control error codes or parameters needed
troubleshooting.cause: W5E-UT electronic control manual not available in current documentation
troubleshooting.solution: Request W5E electronic control manual from Jack. In the interim, refer to W4-UT or W4-D electronic manuals if the W5 controller is from the same family. The W5E-specific controller part number is 1JD130023000.

troubleshooting.cause: Stepper motor thread trimmer (W5E-specific) may have wiring or mechanical issue
troubleshooting.solution: Check stepper motor (part 7RJ37007) connections. Refer to parts diagram section 26 (W5E步进剪线专用件) for component identification.

mechanicalSetup.threading: 2-thread and 3-thread configurations. Follow threading diagram on machine body.
mechanicalSetup.oilLevel: Maintain ISO VG22 oil between H (high) and L (low) marks. Manual lubrication (2-3 drops) required after extended non-use.
mechanicalSetup.presserFoot: Adjust presser foot height based on fabric thickness (0.5-5.1mm range).
mechanicalSetup.threadTension: Two tension knobs (knob 1 and knob 2) for thread tension adjustment.
mechanicalSetup.differentialRatio: Adjustable differential ratio for fabric type.
